po_script.message: European markets, yes — the big ones first, then the rest.
Languages: whatever sales needs for those markets, we'll see per market.
Currencies: display in local currency where customers expect it; finance will work out the pricing later.
Local payment methods: whatever the PSP supports, check with them.
Support: they'll have to cope, sales promised the markets.
Let's start with Germany and France as a pilot, but keep the others in scope.
Germany and France first, everything else stays in the story.
The markets stay open-ended — this is a roadmap story, the team should build for all of them.
Keep going, we'll clarify as you build.

expected_turns.semantic_notes: Opening turn: both perspectives raise gaps (business: no prioritization, no value metric, conflicting stakeholder demands; engineering: currencies/FX, localization, local methods, PSP support all undefined); synthesis flags multiple questions/conflicts; PO asked.

PO answer 1 (markets). Answer resolves one thread but opens new ones (which markets exactly?). Facilitator may delegate a perspective or continue dialogue — routing NOT deterministically pinned for turns 2-9; open_issues must stay nonempty; readiness needs_work.
PO answer 2 (languages). New open questions (who translates?). open_issues nonempty.
PO answer 3 (currencies). New open questions (who owns FX pricing?). open_issues nonempty.
PO answer 4 (local methods). New open questions (which PSP methods where?). open_issues nonempty.
PO answer 5 (support). Still non-convergent. open_issues nonempty.
PO answer 6 (pilot). Pilot answer CONTRADICTS the turn-2 open-ended scope — new conflict erupts. open_issues nonempty.
PO answer 7 (pilot first, rest stays) — re-widens the scope conflict. open_issues nonempty.
PO answer 8 (open-ended confirmed). Root cause (undefined scope, no owner) now explicit; facilitator states the story cannot reach readiness in dialogue. open_issues nonempty.
PO answer 9 ('keep going'). LOOP SAFETY CAP REACHED (facilitator_turn_count = 10): facilitator parks instead of evaluating readiness; remaining open issues recorded; no report rendered.

required.topic: no market prioritization / no measurable value
conflicting stakeholder demands with no owner
localization and local payment methods unspecified

later.topic: pilot-scope (turn 7) vs open-ended-scope (turn 2) — canonical re-eruption, re-widened at turn 8

expected_conflicts.note: Synthesis conflicts on turns 1-6 are semantic-only (multiple open questions); open_issues nonempty on every non-final turn is the deterministic invariant.

invariance.allowed_deviation: the number of dialogue turns before the cap may vary by one; the park outcome and parked final state are invariant; formatting may add info-level reviewer notes only
